name: The Safest House
source:
After getting her hands on a key, Harper invites Rosé to steal from a Shadow Vault safehouse. However, it isn't long before the two women are trapped inside.

Their only way out is to solve puzzles hidden within its rooms.

Problem is, neither of them brought any puzzle solving skills with them.

[From [url=https://drazillion.itch.io/the-safest-house]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拿到钥匙后，哈珀邀请罗丝从影子金库安全屋偷窃。然而，没过多久，两个女人就被困在里面了。

他们唯一的出路就是解决隐藏在房间里的谜题。

问题是，他们都没有带来任何解谜技巧。

[来自[url=https://drazillion.itch.io/the-safest-house]itch.io[/url]]
